Commentary.Commentary: The Zimbabwe players have spread out on the field. Mohammad Naim and Soumya Sarkar are the opening batsmen for Bangladesh. Blessing Muzarabani has been given the ball to start proceedings. A wide slip in place, let's begin...

So, here we go. We are back for the run chase. It will be interesting to see if the star man Tamim not being there makes any difference. Also, Zimbabwe would feel they are at least 30-40 runs short given the way they started their innings. We will find out as we go along as to how this one unfolds.

Right then, 153 needed for Bangladesh to win. Have Zimbabwe put enough runs on the board to give their bowlers a chance or will Bangladesh run away with this one as well? Stay tuned to find out as we will be back in a jiffy.

Bangladesh did not start particularly well with the ball even though Mustafizur Rahman got a wicket in the second over. It took them time to break the 2nd wicket partnership and once Shakib Al Hasan got Wesley Madhevere, they kept on picking wickets regularly and crawled their way back into the game. Shoriful Islam bowled beautifully and Shakib Al Hasan was consistent as usual. In the end, the Fizz cleaned up the tail and the visitors would be happier of the two teams going into the break.

Excellent comeback by Bangladesh in the second half of the match as they picked up 8 wickets for just 61 runs in the last 10 overs. Zimbabwe got off to a brisk start and even though they lost a wicket in the second over, Regis Chakabva kept on hammering the Bangladeshi bowlers all over the place and he had support from Wesley Madhevere. Then Shakib Al Hasan came in and dismissed Wesley Madhevere to break the 64-run stand. Regis Chakabva was dismissed soon after, courtesy of an excellent piece of work from Nurul Hasan. After that Dion Myers was the only one to make an impact with the bat and Zimbabwe ended up getting bowled out with a sub-par total of 152.

OUT! Bowled 'em! No doubt about this wicket. Mustafizur Rahman delivers his trademark slower delivery, on a length and around leg, Blessing Muzarabani once again opens his stance to go big over the leg side but is early into the swing of his bat. The ball arrives late and pegs the leg stump back. ZIMBABWE ARE ALL OUT FOR 152!
FOUR! 150 comes up! A length ball around off, Blessing Muzarabani clears his front leg and hammers his heave to the deep mid-wicket fence.
FOUR! Too full in length and wide outside off, Blessing squeezes it out past short third man for a boundary.

Great sportsman spirit shown by Nurul Hasan! A very full ball outside off, angling away, Blessing tries to dig it out but misses and it goes behind off the outside edge. Nurul Hassan dives across to his right to catch the ball but as his hands hit the ground, the ball comes out of his gloves. The finger has gone up but Nurul is quick to tell that he has not taken it cleanly.
Blessing Muzarabani is the last man in for Zimbabwe.

OUT! Sound of timber! You will not see a better yorker than this! An inswinging one, right at the base of the middle stump, not much that Richard Ngarava can do. He still tries his best to get his bat down but it's all too late. The stumps are rattled and Zimbabwe's innings continue to slip.
Slower one, full and outside off, pushed to covers for a single.
Fuller in length and on off, pushed back to the bowler. Two wickets and 7 runs from the over, top stuff!
Who will come in next? It's going to be Richard Ngarava.

OUT! A running stunner by the substitute fielder, Shamim Hossain. This one is a magnificent take, a ripper! Back of a length ball on middle, Burl decides that it's time to flex his muscles and powers it over wide mid on. Shamim Hossain reacts quickly from long on, runs across to his left and catches the ball safely. That's not all though. Not only he judged the catch to perfection but after falling and sliding near the fence, he does a commendable job to keep himself away from touching the fence. Shamim stays in that position and lifts his finger to show that it's a clean catch. The umpires though still take it upstairs and the soft signal is out. It stays out after the replays. Exceptional stuff!
Commentary.Howout: c sub Shamim Hossain b Mohammad Saifuddin

Commentary.Commentary: On middle, a length ball, Wellington nudges it to mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery, on middle, eased down towards long on for a couple.
Who will come in next? It's going to be Wellington Masakadza in at number 9!

OUT! Drags it on! Luke Jongwe tries to be too cheeky and pays a big price for it. Mohammad Saifuddin comes up with a sharp yorker-length ball wide outside off, Luke walks across the stumps for the paddle scoop but it takes the inner half of his blade and goes on to disturb the stumps. Had it missed the stumps, it would have been a boundary. Idea was good from Jongwe but not the execution.

FOUR! Poor delivery to start the over and it gets the deserved treatment. Short in length and wide outside off, Jongwe reaches out for it with an open-faced bat and slaps it past backward point for a boundary.
Angling away from the batsman, outside off, Jongwe places it to the right of short third man and collects a single. Good over, only 6 from it.
Smart bowling by the Fizz. He follows the batsman down the leg side by dartings a length ball, Burl fails to work it around and is hit on the body. They steal a leg bye.

Another slower delivery from Mustafizur Rahman. It's around off and Luke taps it down in front of backward point. They cross for a quick run as the fielder scores a direct hit at the striker's end. Burl is safe though. The ball deflects off the stumps to square leg but no extra run taken.
Short in length and wide outside off, slower in pace, Jongwe reaches out but steers it straight to short third man.
RUN OUT appeal! The square leg umpire sends this one upstairs as it looks close.

SAFE! The keeper never collected the ball. A near yorker around leg, Jongwe digs it out towards square leg and scampers back for the second run. The throw comes to the keeper who fails to gather it and breaks the stumps with his gloves as Jongwe dives back in. A direct hit would have got Luke!
Slower length ball on off, a cutter, Burl quietly works it through mid-wicket and wants two. Only one run is possible though.
Bowling change. Mustafizur Rahman comes back in. So far he has figures of, 2-0-17-1!
Too full in length this time, outside off, Luke squeezes it out but finds the point fielder. 10 from the over!

FOUR! Well placed! Short in length and wide outside off, the bowler has run his fingers on the seam and hence it's a slower one. But Luke Jongwe waits for it on the back foot and cuts it through the gap between backward point and short third man for a boundary.
Full again and this time the line is straight, Luke flicks it in the gap at mid-wicket and takes a couple.
Fuller in length and on middle, Ryan works it to mid-wicket and Mohammad Saifuddin runs after it. Good work to restrict them to a single.

Dropped? Seems like it didn't carry to the keeper. On a good length and outside off, Jongwe pushes tamely inside the line and gets a soft edge behind. It's dying down on Nurul Hasan who reacts well but fails to gather it cleanly. The replays have now confirmed that it did carry and it was a dropped catch. The batsmen crossed.
Fuller in length and outside off, Luke drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
5 overs to go! Mohammad Saifuddin is back into the attack. He has been very impressive so far. 2-0-6-0 are his figures so far.
Fuller one, again on leg stump and this time it's pushed down to wide of long on for one.
Slower bouncer on middle, going across the batsman. Luke Jongwe tries to guide it down to third man but misses.
Length this time on middle and once again nicely blocked out.
Short again, this time into the body and Luke Jongwe watchfully blocks it out.
Good short one around off, Luke Jongwe taps it down towards short third man.
Luke Jongwe is in next.

OUT! TIMBER! PEACH! Shoriful Islam bowled an excellent near yorker, in fact, very full, bang on off stump. The ball was angling across and Dion Myers looked to heave it over mid-wicket by clearing his front leg, chose a difficult shot to play and paid the price. The off stump is uprooted. Bangladesh and Shoriful Islam are ecstatic as the dangerous Dion Myers is sent back to the pavilion.
Shakib is bowled out. Who will now bowl from this end? Shoriful Islam is back on. 1/16 in his 2 overs so far.

Bowled shorter this time on middle and Myers pulls it to deep mid-wicket for another single to end the over. There is some confusion out in the middle. The umpire has signalled for FOUR overthrows as well. Not too sure what transpired as no replays have been shown yet but as per the on-air commentators, it was some sloppy work by Bangladesh to not back the throw.
Length again outside off, Burl moves across and nudges the ball towards mid on for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Myers cuts it to deep point for a single.
Length ball on the pads, flicked to square leg by Burl for one.
Ryan Burl walks in next.

OUT! LBW! Fuller delivery on middle, Tarisai Musakanda looks to flick it onto the leg side but there's not much feet movement. He misses the ball, gets rapped on the pads and is trapped in front. Soumya Sarkar appeals and this time the umpire has no hesitation in giving it OUT. Bangladesh just keep picking wickets.
Back of a length around off and cut nicely towards the cover region for a single.
This one is bowled flatter on leg and Myers flicks it off the back foot to square leg for one. 9 runs from the over without taking any risk. That's the end of Shakib with the ball, 4-0-28-1!
Slightly shorter on middle and pushed gently towards the mid-wicket region for another couple.
A bit flatter, skidding in and flicked to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Excellent running between the wickets.
Good running! Myers pushes the tossed up ball on middle towards long on and an early call gives them two runs.
Tossed up on off, pushed down the ground through mid on for a single as the bowler himself ran behind it.
Bowled slightly flatter as the batsman comes down the track and pushes it to long on for one.
Bowling change. Shakib Al Hasan to bowl out here. 1/19 in his 3 overs so far.
Length ball around off, forced off the back foot to the cover region.
FOUR! HAMMERED! Fuller one on off, Tarisai Musakanda just leans into the lofted straight drive and hits it back past the bowler and into the fence at long off.
Back of a length and punched off the back foot, down the ground for one.

CLOSE! Soumya Sarkar pitches it up on off and the ball nips back in. Tarisai Musakanda plays all around it onto the pads and a shout is turned down. The batsmen sneak a run. That inside edge saved him, otherwise, Tarisai was plumb in front.
Length ball on off, pushed down to long off for a single by Myers.
Soumya Sarkar is into the attack now.
Fuller one on middle and leg, flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball around off, Tarisai Musakanda just blocks it out. End of a fantastic over, two big wickets and just one run off it!
Tarisai Musakanda is the new batsman.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Islam pulls the length back just a bit and serves it on off stump, angling across. Sikandar Raza tries to cut way too close to his body but gets the outside edge straight into the mitts of Nurul Hasan. The skipper departs for a duck and Bangladesh are right on top of things now.
Commentary.Howout: c Nurul Hasan b Shoriful Islam

Commentary.Commentary: Islam bowls the cutter this time, on a length just outside off. Raza tries to push at it but the ball sneaks below his bat.
Quick short one around off, Raza ducks under it.
Back of a length, punched off the back foot down the ground for a single.
Skipper Sikandar Raza is in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Regis Chakabva tries to shuffle across and scoop the short ball around off over the keeper's head but gets it away off the gloves. Nurul Hasan just can't reach it in time to put in a dive for the catch but sees the batsmen trying to sneak a run. The keeper rushes forward, removes his gloves, picks up the ball and has a shy at the bowler's end. Shoriful there tried to stop the ball by raising his left hand up but luckily for Bangladesh, he fails to do that. It's a direct hit at the bowler's end, they appeal, it's referred upstairs and the replays find Regis Chakabva short. That's a hammer blow to Zimbabwe!
Shout for a run out! Great game awareness shown by the keeper. Is Regis Chakabva run out? Oh yes, a massive breakthrough for the Bangla Tigers.
Bowling change. Shoriful Islam comes back in.

FOUR! Second boundary in the over and Zimbabwe are 91/2 at the halfway mark. Mahmudullah loses his line this time and bowls a flatter delivery down the leg side, Myers gets down and smartly paddles it wide of short fine leg for a boundary.
Full and flighted on off, it's eased straight down the ground and a couple of runs have been taken.
FOUR! That's a good shot! Mahmudullah serves a shortish ball outside off, Myers hangs on the back foot and hammers it through covers for a boundary. Lovely placement from the debutant.
A long hop on middle, Regis turns and pulls it through square leg fr a single.
Slightly short and on off, Dion gets back and forces it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted ball on off, Myers pushes it with gentle hands to long on and comes back for the second run.
Bowling change. The skipper, Mahmudullah comes in to roll his arms.
Gets back and this time eases it through mid-wicket for a single. Top over by a top bowler!
Mishit! Shakib fires one flat and short ball on off, Myers rocks back to cut but it takes the toe end of the bat. The batter needs to be careful with this shot close to his body.
Flatter ball, short and around off, Chakabva moves across and works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up ball, landing full on middle, Dion opens his account by pushing it down to long on for a run.
Fires a flat ball around leg, Myers tries to flick on the leg side but misses.
Who will come in next? It's going to be Dion Myers.

OUT! An excellent return catch by Shakib Al Hasan. It's an arm ball, landing full around off and skidding back in, Wesley Madhevere moves back to open the off side field as he attempts for the inside-out shot over covers. But it skids back in to take the inner half of the bat and loops back to the bowler. Shakib jumps a bit and catches it over his head. End of a 64-run stand and Bangladesh will be feeling a bit easy now.
A good comeback from the off-spinner, fires in a yorker on middle and off, Regis digs it out. 18 from the over and Zimbabwe are on the charge!
SIX! Regis Chakabva is unstoppable. This time he reaches the pitch of the delivery and clobbers it flat over the bowler's head. Mahedi is under big pressure here.

SIX! Regis Chakabva has sent this ball way into the stands! Tossed up ball landing full around off, Chakabva attacks it with all his power and dismisses it over wide long on. He is looking in fine form yet again!
Uppish but safe! Short in length and outside off, Wesley uses his feet and then cuts it through point for a run.
Uses his feet to dance down the track and eases a full ball to long off for one. Smart batting!
FOUR! Great shot to welcome the bowler! Full and flighted outside off, Regis Chakabva sits down on one knee and hammers it down to long on for a boundary. The 50-run stand comes up, off 33 balls.
Bowling change. Mahedi Hasan comes in to replace Mohammad Saifuddin.

Sees the batsman coming down the track and darts a flat ball down the leg side, Regis fails to work it around and it goes off his pads to point. The batsmen take a leg bye. Bangladesh have pulled things back in the last two overs.
Flatter one, full and on off, worked through mid-wicket another run. Liton Das is seen limping off the field, hopefully, nothing serious.
Fires a very full ball on middle, Regis Chakabva tries to heave but it takes the bottom edge and goes to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up ball outside off, Regis walks down the track and knocks it in the gap at mid-wicket for two.
Short in length and wide outside off, Chakbva tries to cut but mistimes it badly. The ball rolls towards cover-point.
Flighted delivery, fuller in length and outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Bowling change. Shakib Al Hasan comes back in. So far he has figures of, 1-0-11-0!
Pacy delivery, very full and speared on leg,  Wesley tried to heave but missed. They crossed and it's given as a run. So maybe there was some inside edge. 50/1 in the Powerplay!
A touch short and on off, Regis moves back to make room and cuts it to the right of point for a run.
Forces a full ball down to long on and picks up a single.
A cracking pull shot is played to a short ball but it finds the fielder inside the ring at mid-wicket.
Width on offer outside off, Wesley Madhevere throws his bat at it but gets it away off the bottom edge.

Tight single! Mohammad Saifuddin follows the batsman down the leg side with a length ball, Regis defends it from the bottom half of his bat and the ball rolls on the surface. They cross for a brisk run as the bowler also charges towards the ball.
Mohammad Saifuddin to bowl the final over of the Powerplay.
Back of a length and Regis Chakabva pulls it nicely to fine leg for one.
FOUR! Slower one straying onto the pads and Regis Chakabva very skillfully tickles it down fine to the right of fine leg for a boundary.
Shorter one on top of leg, Wesley Madhevere tries to pull a bit too hard and gets it on the toe end of the bat to short fine leg for a single.
Nicely done again by Mustafizur Rahman who uses the slower delivery again. This one was pitched up on off and Wesley Madhevere got a leading edge while trying to block it.
BEAUTY! On a length around off, going across the right-hander. Wesley Madhevere tries to drive away from the body but misses.
Full on the pads, Wesley Madhevere hangs back and flicks it to deep square leg for a couple.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
Fuller one this time on middle and leg, hit on the up through mid on but not with great timing. The batsmen do come back for the third. 15 from the over, a big one for Zimbabwe.
A good bouncer! It was fast and just around off, Wesley Madhevere smartly just allowed it to go.
A bit full and wide, driven to deep cover for one.
FOUR! Length ball on middle and what a shot from Regis Chakabva. He just shuffles across and scoops the ball over the keeper's head and into the fence.
Back of a length around off, guided nicely to third man for a single.
SIX! Pitched up delivery and Wesley Madhevere just opens his arms and hits it back over the bowler's head for a stunning maximum.
Change in the attack. Shoriful Islam comes in to replace Mustafizur Rahman.
FOUR! Dragged down on middle and Regis Chakabva gives himself room to smash it through extra cover for a boundary.

A bit shorter in length on middle, Regis Chakabva tries to reverse sweep but the ball comes off his wrists and the keeper catches it. Slight appeals for an LBW as well as caught behind, but not given.
FOUR! Put away by Regis Chakabva! Shakib drags his length short and lands it on middle and leg, Chakabva camps back and pulls it powerfully to the square leg fence.
Wide! Quicker one, fired down the leg side, Regis wanted to sweep but missed.
Shakib fires a flatter delivery on middle and leg, Wellington Masakadza moves back and works it wide of mid-wicket for a run.
Skidding back in from around off, Wesley moves back and works it to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery, full and around off, Chakabva walks down the track and pushes it to long on for a run.
Shakib Al Hasan to bowl the third over.
A good length ball on middle, Wesley Madhevere turns it in the gap at mid-wicket and it's wide of the fielder at mid on. Two runs taken to close an eventful over, 9 runs and a wicket from it.
Regis Chakabva is the new batsman at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! STUNNING CATCH! Mustafizur Rahman again bowls a slower one into the pitch wide outside off and Tadiwanashe Marumani, who was already looking a bit edgy, can't hold back and goes for the big heave on the leg side. Due to the slowness of the delivery, the batsman is way early into his shot and lofts it high in the vacant mid-wicket region. But out of nowhere Soumya Sarkar comes running in and dives to take a fabulous catch to get the first wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Soumya Sarkar b Mustafizur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Slower full toss, straying down leg and Tadiwanashe Marumani will be disappointed to have missed out on that one as his flicks just comes off his pads and straight to the keeper.
Third man comes up. Mid-wicket drops back.
Quick, short one this time outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani tries to pull it across but gets beaten by pace.

The search for the ball is on! One of the Bangladesh players is searching for it in the empty stands. The umpire has called for the replacement ball. Hang on, it seems they have found the previous one. Play resumes.
SIX! HUGE HIT! Length ball on the pads and Tadiwanashe Marumani just picks it up and launches it into the stands over the deep mid-wicket fence for the first maximum of the day.
Rahman starts with a full and wide one, angling away. Wesley Madhevere slashes hard at it and the ball goes off the outer half of the blade towards third man for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman to operate from the other end. One slip stays.
Leg Bye! Length ball straying on the pads, Wesley Madhevere misses the flick and gets hit onto his pads. The ball deflects towards mid-wicket for a leg bye.
And Tadiwanashe Marumani is off the mark as well. Full ball around off, driven straight to mid-off and a quick single is taken.
Peach! Pitched up around off, nipping away and Tadiwanashe Marumani almost edges it while trying to cut.
Very full and fast outside off, Tadiwanashe Marumani goes through with his attempted cover drive but fails to connect.
Fuller ball around off, just a hint of swing and Wesley Madhevere flicks it towards deep square leg for a single and he's off the mark.
Back of a length to start with. It was outside off and Wesley Madhevere just fends it away back towards the bowler.

We're done and dusted with everything related to the build-up. It's time to get the ball rolling. Sikandar Raza has a word with the two openers, Tadiwanashe Marumani and Wesley Madhevere before they go out to the middle. Bangladesh are taking the field as well. Mohammad Saifuddin to begin proceedings. One slip in place. All in readiness. Here we go...
Time for the national anthems! The players have lined up in the middle. We are moments away from the first ball.

Mahmudullah, the captain of Bangladesh, says that they would have bowled first anyway as the pitch won't change much and they have a good batting depth. Adds that they have played some great cricket and they want to follow that in this series as well. Shares that they have a good bowling set-up and he is happy with the balance as there are a few all-rounders.

Sikandar Raza, the skipper of Zimbabwe, says that they are batting first as the surface looks good and once they have the runs on the board, it's not easy to chase. Feels that they have a young squad and they want to give them no scoreboard pressure. Adds that this is the format the youngsters enjoy the most and he is looking forward to a good game.

Pitch report - Big boundaries on one side and something for the captains to consider. The pitch looks like an absolute belter. There is a tinge of green on the surface but the sun is out, baking the surface and it will be great for batting. 156 is the average score here in the first innings but if you bat well, 180-190 is on.

Bangladesh (Playing XI) - Mohammad Naim, Liton Das, Shakib Al Hasan, Soumya Sarkar, Mahmudullah (C), Afif Hossain, Nurul Hasan (WK), Mahedi Hasan, Mohammad Saifuddin, Mustafizur Rahman, Shoriful Islam.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Regis Chakabva (WK), Tadiwanashe Marumani, Wesley Madhevere, Tarisai Musakanda, Sikandar Raza (C), Ryan Burl, Dion Myers (On debut), Luke Jongwe, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Richard Ngarava.

Toss - The conditions here in Harare are bright and sunny as the two captains walk out to the centre. It's time to flick the coin. Mahmudullah calls it incorrectly and Sikandar Raza says that ZIMBABWE WILL BAT FIRST!

Key information! Sikandar Raza will be leading Zimbabwe as Brendan Taylor is rested. The hosts are already without Sean Williams and Craig Ervine, so their squad has been depleted further. For Bangladesh, Mushfiqur Rahim had pulled out of the white-ball tour earlier and now Tamim Iqbal is out with a knee injury. Bangladesh would be without two key members of their batting unit but still hold the upper hand due to the quality they possess in their squad.

Get ready, folks! It's time for the most exciting format of the game in Zimbabwe. The Harare Sports Club is ready to host yet another 3-match series and this time the home team would be hoping to start on a brighter note. Zimbabwe have so far lost everything from the time Bangladesh have stepped on their soil and would be trying to make use of the shortest format to bounce back. Bangladesh, on the other hand, have flexed their muscles on this tour and would be eyeing to extend their dominance with yet another clean sweep. More information regarding the first T20I coming your way shortly. Stay tuned.
